name: kr-humanizer
description: Review and rewrite Korean text with explicit, user-approved changes

interface.shortDescription: Review Korean writing before accepting rewrites.
interface.longDescription: Diagnose paragraphs and text hygiene, compare Korean rewrites sentence by sentence, mark reordered ideas, and let the writer accept each change.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use KR-humanizer to review this Korean text and show every proposed change before applying it.
